fields.name: vault
fields.meaning: the ERC4626 vault to deposit into; it must be a granted substrate of this market

fields.name: vaultAssetAmount
fields.meaning: amount of that vault's underlying asset to supply, in the asset's smallest unit; the fuse caps it at the Plasma Vault's balance

fields.name: minSharesOut
fields.meaning: slippage floor: fewer shares than this reverts with Erc4626SupplyFuseInsufficientShares

fields.name: vault
fields.meaning: the ERC4626 vault to withdraw from; it must be a granted substrate of this market

fields.name: vaultAssetAmount
fields.meaning: amount of underlying asset to withdraw, in the asset's smallest unit

fields.name: maxSharesBurned
fields.meaning: slippage ceiling on burned shares; 0 means no limit, and burning more reverts with Erc4626SupplyFuseExcessiveSharesBurned

substrates.meaning: the ERC4626 vault addresses this market may supply to and withdraw from. Both fuses read the same list: the action fuse checks data.vault on enter and exit, and the balance fuse iterates it. The action fuse's file comment calls them assets, but the value checked is the vault address.

valuation.pricedAssets: the underlying asset of every ERC4626 vault in the substrate list, after convertToAssets on the shares the Plasma Vault holds
valuation.priceSource: the vault's PriceOracleMiddlewareManager, falling back to the PriceOracleMiddleware it points at

roles.execute: ALPHA_ROLE (200) calls PlasmaVault.execute with the fuse action
roles.registerFuses: FUSE_MANAGER_ROLE (300) adds the action fuse and the balance fuse
roles.configureLimits: ATOMIST_ROLE (100) sets the market limit that AssetDistributionProtectionLib enforces
roles.configurePriceSources: PRICE_ORACLE_MIDDLEWARE_MANAGER_ROLE (1200) adds the price source for each priced asset

fields.name: curveStableswapNG
fields.meaning: the Curve StableSwap-NG pool (which is also its own LP token) to add liquidity to; it must be a granted substrate of this market

fields.name: asset
fields.meaning: the pool coin to deposit single-sided; it must be one of the pool's coins() or the fuse reverts with CurveStableswapNGSingleSideSupplyFuseUnsupportedPoolAsset

fields.name: assetAmount
fields.meaning: amount of that coin to deposit, in the coin's smallest unit; 0 is a no-op

fields.name: minLpTokenAmountReceived
fields.meaning: slippage floor on LP tokens minted (18 decimals), passed to add_liquidity

fields.name: curveStableswapNG
fields.meaning: the Curve StableSwap-NG pool to remove liquidity from; it must be a granted substrate of this market

fields.name: lpTokenAmount
fields.meaning: amount of LP tokens to burn (18 decimals); 0 is a no-op

fields.name: asset
fields.meaning: the single pool coin to receive; must be one of the pool's coins()

fields.name: minCoinAmountReceived
fields.meaning: slippage floor on the coin received, in its smallest unit; a failing remove_liquidity_one_coin is caught and only emits CurveSupplyStableswapNGSingleSideSupplyFuseExitFailed

substrates.meaning: the Curve StableSwap-NG pool addresses (each pool is its own LP token) this market may add liquidity to and remove from. The action fuse checks data.curveStableswapNG on enter and exit; the balance fuse iterates the same list and reads each pool's balances() and coins().

valuation.pricedAssets: every coin of every substrate pool, pro rata: pool.balances(j) * lpBalance / totalSupply for each coin j, priced individually; rewards and gauge stakes are not included
valuation.priceSource: the vault's PriceOracleMiddleware (PlasmaVaultLib.getPriceOracleMiddleware) via getAssetPrice for each coin

fields.name: asset
fields.meaning: the token to supply to the Comet: its base token or one of its collateral assets; it must be a granted substrate of this market

fields.name: amount
fields.meaning: amount to supply, in the token's smallest unit; 0 is a no-op

fields.name: asset
fields.meaning: the token to withdraw from the Comet; it must be a granted substrate of this market

fields.name: amount
fields.meaning: amount to withdraw, in the token's smallest unit; capped at the Plasma Vault's Comet balance (balanceOf for the base token, collateralBalanceOf otherwise)

additionalFuses.purpose: claims COMP rewards for one Comet through CometRewards.claimTo into the RewardsClaimManager; registered there by FUSE_MANAGER_ROLE (300) and executed by CLAIM_REWARDS_ROLE (600) through RewardsClaimManager.claimRewards, not through PlasmaVault.execute. It has no MARKET_ID: one deployment serves every Comet of the chain.

fields.name: comet_
fields.meaning: the Comet whose accrued rewards are claimed for the Plasma Vault

the deployed runtime code contains claim(address) 0x1e83409a

substrates.meaning: token addresses the Comet accepts: its base token (USDC) and its collateral assets. The supply fuse checks data.asset on enter and exit; the balance fuse iterates the list and reads the Comet balance of each. The Comet itself is not a substrate: it is bound at construction (Comet cUSDCv3 0xc3d688B66703497DAA19211EEdff47f25384cdc3 for this deployment) and one fuse pair is deployed per Comet, which is why each Comet has its own market ID.

valuation.pricedAssets: for every substrate asset, the Plasma Vault's Comet balance (balanceOf for the base token, collateralBalanceOf for collateral), minus the Comet borrowBalanceOf in base token; a net negative value reverts on the int256 to uint256 cast
valuation.priceSource: the Comet's own price feeds through Comet.getPrice (baseTokenPriceFeed for the base token, getAssetInfoByAddress(asset).priceFeed for collateral), 8 decimals; the vault's PriceOracleMiddleware is not consulted
